source: Report-only single-flow capture of the already-accepted assembled leg TestCF003AssembledAuthMagicCodeDenied (@ 356d68d) plus a deterministically seeded expired-magic-code leg, under FU-02 Option A; no corpusctl recorder behavior change, no v1 oracle. The expired leg is seeded at fixture setup by inserting a magic-code triple pair with created_at backdated 48h (past the 24h TTL); no sleep is involved.
redaction: CF-002 discipline: volatile transport headers (Date, Content-Length, Transfer-Encoding) excluded; no credential-bearing headers present on these exchanges so no header redaction applies; application payload keys retained exactly and remain comparison-significant. No tokens, timestamps, DSNs, or database URLs appear in these bytes.
excluded: The post-denial guest sign-in leg is excluded from these bytes with reason: its response mints fresh UUID identity/token values, so exact byte replay is impossible. Guest sign-in is a live post-denial shape check only (values asserted live, never checked in); it is not a no-residue proof. The 401 legs DO persist auth_throttle failure rows (2 for the invalid-code email, 1 for the expired-code email, all below the 5-attempt lockout threshold), asserted exactly by the replay test.
